title: Your home beyond the inherited rules

captions.energy: Making home fit an accepted model
captions.emotions: Hoping for routines of your own

meaning: Hope for a comfortable home sustains you, but received ideas about proper housekeeping can obscure your actual needs.
text: You want to see care taking a living shape at home: something growing, favourite things finding their places, an ordinary evening becoming more pleasant. The Empress in the physical position of Muladhara describes this gradual making of a home. The Hierophant in energy creates tension between your comfort and ideas about how a household ought to be arranged. The Star in emotions keeps hope alive: beyond the compulsory rules, you can still picture a way of living that is truly yours. That expectation warms you, although everyday freedom may remain some distance away.

Imagine wanting a small dining table beside the window. Yet the room already holds a large one kept for formal gatherings. You look after it and buy a tablecloth, while eating breakfast in turns in the kitchen. **The home you hope for comes closer through room for your ordinary life.** You want to sit by the window together now. That wish has sufficient meaning of its own, even without approval from the familiar model.

The difficulty is reassuring yourselves that home will surely become yours one day. While received requirements go unquestioned, hope can remain a beautiful distant plan. You continue caring for a space that barely answers your wishes and grow tired of your own patience. Respecting a tradition need not postpone the possibility of making yourselves at home today.
